snippet.title: Meeple Incremental - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Meeple Incremental is coming to Steam in 2026, wishlist now!
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4353350
Roll dice to move Meeples around the board and collect money, skill points, and capsule tickets. Unlock unique skills and minigames, powerful collectibles, and automate dice rolls to increase your income.
